# NullVPN

> NullVPN is a privacy-first VPN service built for difficult networks: passwordless sign-in, automatic backup routes, instant setup, and no activity logs. One service plan with monthly, quarterly, and annual billing, payable by debit/credit card or crypto (USDT / TON). The website is fully available in 7 languages and keeps a TON Web3 presence that stays reachable when the main site is blocked. Sign-up and account management run through the Telegram bot @nullvpnnetbot.

The comparison page holds an honest feature-by-feature table against NordVPN, ExpressVPN, and ProtonVPN. Refunds: full refund within 48 hours if the service does not work in your location. Deep links: most content surfaces (FAQ answers, pricing plans, features rows, comparison rows/columns, legal clauses) can be linked to directly via their URL fragments.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://nullvpn.net/): overview of the service, core promises, and quick start.
- [Features](https://nullvpn.net/features.html): privacy, reliability, payments, speed, and accessibility deep-dives; each row is deep-linkable.
- [Pricing](https://nullvpn.net/pricing.html): the single plan with monthly, quarterly, and annual billing periods and payment options.
- [Comparison](https://nullvpn.net/comparison.html): feature-by-feature table versus NordVPN, ExpressVPN, and ProtonVPN; rows and columns are deep-linkable.
- [How it works](https://nullvpn.net/how-it-works.html): why it differs from consumer VPNs and how the tunnel handles restrictive networks.
- [Download](https://nullvpn.net/download.html): official Android builds with checksums published on GitHub Releases.
- [Web3 / TON](https://nullvpn.net/web3.html): how to reach the service over TON when the website is blocked.
- [FAQ](https://nullvpn.net/faq.html): searchable, category-filtered answers on how it works, privacy, payments, and devices.
- [Contact](https://nullvpn.net/contact.html): support channels and community links.

## Legal

## Support

- Telegram support: https://t.me/nullvpn_net
- Email: support@nullvpn.net
- Telegram bot (sign-up and account management): https://t.me/nullvpnnetbot

## Languages

Every page is served from a single URL per language; text is switched client-side. Append `?lang=xx` to any URL to open it in a specific language — supported codes: en (English), ru (Russian), fa (Farsi), ar (Arabic), es (Spanish), ne (Nepali), fr (French). The choice persists for the visitor across the site.

## Security

Security researchers: vulnerability reports are accepted through the channels listed in the RFC 9116 file at /.well-known/security.txt (same channels as Support above).

## Privacy engineering

- Outbound links carry referrerpolicy="no-referrer" — following a link never leaks the visitor's page URL (including ?lang=xx and deep-link fragments) to third-party hosts.
- The site ships no client-side tracking, no cookies, and no third-party scripts beyond its own first-party assets.
